standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, human. What can I do for you?
Protecting the camp from wildlife and thieves.

standard-dialogue.player: What about the giant monster up there?

standard-dialogue.npc: Hah! Why would I rush up there when you foolish humans are more than willing to throw yourself into its jaws?
Besides, someone needs to keep an eye on the happenings down here.
It is hungry work though, and we don't have the most interesting supplies up here.
Got me thinking about those sunlight antelope. Quite an interesting flavour, but I think we can do even more...
Anyway, I shouldn't really be talking to you. Move along, please.

standard-dialogue-with-raw-sunlight-ante.npc: Oh, is that sunlight antelope meat you're carrying?
Come closer, I have a request to make.
Sitting up here under the looming threat of death at the jaws of a giant beast that tunnels beneath our very feet got me thinking.
Could we combine the sweet stickiness of redberries with the strong, gamey flavour of sunlight antelope?
Don't get me wrong, Marla is cooking up some wonderful stuff considering the circumstances. I just need something a little more adventurous, you know?
I'm sure she'd be happy to experiment if you bring her some raw sunlight antelope and redberries!

steps.player: I suppose I can help out.

steps.npc: Wonderful, thank you! I can't wait to try this!

steps.player: Sorry, I'm a bit busy right now.

steps.npc: Aren't we all? Ah well, maybe another time.

steps.player: I suppose that's fair.

options.text: What did you want me to get you?

steps.player: What did you want me to get you?

steps.npc: I'd like to try redberries combined with sunlight antelope! Marla the chef will prepare it if you take her the raw ingredients.

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.
Never mind.

steps.npc: Okay, bye!

standard-dialogue-with-redberry-antelope.text: Viero enthusiastically takes a large bite and chews thoughtfully.

standard-dialogue-with-redberry-antelope.npc: Well, it's... interesting and complex. Definitely an experience.

standard-dialogue-with-redberry-antelope.text: He takes another bite of the meat.
Viero looks up from his meal.

options.text: Uh, usually there's a reward for doing this sort of thing.

steps.player: Uh, usually there's a reward for doing this sort of thing.

steps.npc: Seriously, human? You couldn't just do this out of kindness? For the enjoyment of the journey and the feeling of helping another?
You weren't helping me out of appreciation for my work here and the service I provide?
Or, at the least, to push the boundaries of culinary achievement?

steps.player: I... uh... of course. Enjoy your meal.

steps.npc: I suppose you can have a bite if you like?

steps.player: I think I'll pass, thanks.
Can I try some?

steps.npc: Oh. Yeah, I suppose so.

steps.text: Viero tears off a chunk of meat and hands it to you. The strong, gamey flavour of the meats gives way to a tart sickly-sweetness that doesn't complement it at all.

steps.player: Interesting and complex is a good way to describe it...

steps.npc: An experience!

steps.player: Enjoy your meal.

steps.npc: Oh, thank you! Have a great day!
